# Zanna Services Runtime Reference

[Back to the runtime reference index](README.md)

## Classes

<a id="zanna-services-platform"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.Platform`

Starts a distribution platform's services and reads identity, licensing, and events.

`Zanna.Services.Platform` is the provider-neutral entry point to store platforms such as Steam.
Call `Init(provider, appId)` once at startup, before creating any window; it returns a
`Zanna.Result` holding the provider id or an error message, and `Status` holds a
`Zanna.Services.Status` code. While a provider is started, `Canvas.Poll` and `Canvas3D.Poll`
pump it every frame (call `Update` in loops without a canvas). Drain events with `PollEvent`,
which returns a `Zanna.Services.EventKind` and exposes the payload through `EventResultCode`,
`EventText`, `EventValue`, and `EventFlag`.

When no provider is started (no Steam client, no redistributable, or a non-Steam build) every
query returns an empty string, `0`, or `false` and never traps, so one build runs everywhere.
Stateful members must be called on the main thread. Call `Shutdown` on the quit path.

<a id="zanna-services-request"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.Request`

Tracks one non-blocking platform services request.

`Zanna.Services.Request` objects are returned by request methods such as
`Platform.RequestPlayerCount`. A request completes during a later provider pump; poll `IsDone`
across frames rather than waiting. `Succeeded`, `ResultCode`, and `Value` describe the result,
and `Error` holds the failure message. Requests that cannot start are returned already
completed as failed, and `Platform.Shutdown` cancels outstanding requests.

<a id="zanna-services-steam"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.Steam`

Exposes Steam-only capabilities of the platform services layer.

`Zanna.Services.Steam` complements `Zanna.Services.Platform` when Steam is the active provider.
`RestartAppIfNecessary(appId)` works before `Platform.Init`: when it returns `true`, Steam is
relaunching the game and the process should exit immediately. `SteamId` is the signed-in
user's SteamID64, `HardwareType` reports a `Zanna.Services.SteamHardware` value, and
`IsUnderProton`, `IsBigPicture`, and `LibraryPath` describe the running environment. Every
query returns a neutral value while Steam is not the active provider.

The provider loads the developer-shipped Steamworks redistributable (`steam_api64.dll`,
`libsteam_api.dylib`, or `libsteam_api.so`) from the executable directory, or from the path in
the `ZANNA_SERVICES_STEAM_LIBRARY` environment variable during development.

<a id="zanna-services-status"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.Status`

Defines platform services status codes.

`Zanna.Services.Status` values are read from `Platform.Status`. `Ok` means a provider is started,
`NotStarted` is the state before `Init` and after `Shutdown`, and the remaining values name why
the last `Init` failed: an unknown provider, a missing or incompatible redistributable library,
an unsupported platform, a platform client that is not running or is too old, or another
initialization failure.

<a id="zanna-services-eventkind"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.EventKind`

Defines platform services event kinds returned by Platform.PollEvent.

`Zanna.Services.EventKind` values identify queued platform events. `ServiceConnected`,
`ServiceDisconnected` (EventResultCode holds the provider result), and `ConnectFailed`
(EventFlag is true while retrying) track the online connection. `OverlayChanged` reports the
platform overlay opening (EventFlag true) or closing; pause single-player games while it is
open. `DlcInstalled` carries the DLC id in EventText and EventValue,
`LaunchParametersChanged` reports a relaunch with new parameters, and `ServiceShutdown` asks
the game to save and shut the provider down. `None` means the queue is empty.

<a id="zanna-services-feature"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.Feature`

Defines platform services feature identifiers for Platform.HasFeature.

`Zanna.Services.Feature` values ask whether the active provider can serve a group of members
right now: `Identity` (UserId, UserName, IsOnline), `Licensing` (IsLicensed, IsDlcInstalled),
`Language`, and `PlayerCount` (RequestPlayerCount). A feature can be unavailable even while a
provider is started, for example when an older redistributable lacks an interface;
`Platform.Diagnostics` then explains why.

### `Zanna.Services.RequestKind`

Defines platform services request kinds reported by Request.Kind.

`Zanna.Services.RequestKind` identifies what a `Zanna.Services.Request` asked for. `PlayerCount`
requests the number of players currently running the game; its `Value` holds the count.

<a id="zanna-services-steamhardware"></a>
### `Zanna.Services.SteamHardware`

Defines Steam hardware identifiers reported by Steam.HardwareType.

`Zanna.Services.SteamHardware` values describe the device the game runs on: `None` for a regular
PC, `SteamDeck`, `SteamMachine`, or `SteamFrame`. `Unknown` is reported while Steam is not the
active provider. Redistributables older than Steamworks SDK 1.65 distinguish only `SteamDeck`
from `None`. Use these values for analytics and default settings, not to gate features.
